answer: Rate limiting at the reef: each subnet fingerprint (ASN + /24) caps at 5 identities per epoch. The pulse of registrations throttles to 1/min per fingerprint, so a farm needs 200 distinct ASNs at ~$50/mo each to field 1000 sybils. The quill logs every fingerprint collision, slashing staked bonds 10% per overlap. Cost scales linearly with subnets while yield stays flat, so marginal ROI inverts before 50 identities. Works because fingerprints are scarce, priced, and auditable.
